description:
* Develops cross-platform mobile applications, which include defining, designing, and maintenance 
 * Works closely with the Application Development Teams/Partners, IT Application & Enterprise Architecture teams, UX Delivery Team, Business Stakeholders & Other Technical Stakeholder 
 teams 
 * Participates in mobile application development efforts in the capacity of a technical subject matter expert 
 * Reports progress and activity to Manager and/or Project Lead on a continuing basis 
 

 Qualifications  

 

 Education and Experience: 
 

 * Bachelor*s degree or higher in Computer Science or related field preferred or equivalent experience 
 * 4+ years of related work experience 
 * Certification in relevant mobile technologies preferred 
 

 Skills & Other Requirements: 
 

 * At least 3 years of experience in Mobile applications development with Android (SDK and NDK) and/or iOS and/or Hybrid Mobile development stack required 
 * Hands-on experience with implementing Front-end application using JavaScript frameworks (jQuery/Angular/Node /Backbone/Kendo/Xamarin), HTML5, CSS3, AJAX technologies required 
 * Strong experience in implementation and integration with web services (SOAP/REST based, JSON, XML) required 
 * Familiarity in implementation of Continuous build and delivery of Mobile Applications

  Mobile UI, iOS, Android, javascript, angular.js, node.js 

 Multiple Openings for GC/Citizen
